info.name: CryptVault
info.summary: Open and manage VeraCrypt-compatible encrypted volumes right inside Nextcloud
info.description: Click a .hc volume file, enter its password, and browse, read, write and manage the files inside — no FUSE, no root, no Docker required. Pure PHP implementation of the VeraCrypt volume format (AES-256-XTS) with FAT and exFAT filesystem support.
info.author: DanversKara
